official_source_url.value: https://consulsen-paris.gouv.sn/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/visaform.pdf — official visa application form ("Demande de Visa de moins de trois mois") issued by the Consulat Général du Sénégal à Paris, Ministère des Affaires Étrangères, lists required supporting documents as "Photocopie Titre de séjour --- Photocopie du Passeport --- Une Photo d'identité (pour visa avec consultation)" — i.e. one ID photo is required for visas requiring prior consultation. The form's photo box has no printed dimension/background text. Senegal's e-visa is otherwise processed via visasenegal.sn / snedai.sn, which returned HTTP 403 to this session's fetch and could not be independently verified.
